text: Fixed radii around the bearer, in inches from the edge of its base, inside which models are affected by (or eligible for) a rule or an item the bearer has: a banner, a Hero's Stand Fast, 'friendly models within 3" of this Hero'. Not auras: weapon ranges, 'in the same combat', a radius around somebody else (receiver-side rules), around an objective, a marker or a target. An entry is found on a unit by `source` (item, rule or power names; the Hero rules of the rulebook; a heroic action); `kind` is the colour group, `when` and `group` say which dialog switch governs it. Rings of one figure with the same kind, radius and tier are merged (labels joined). `replaces` lists entries that the bearer does not get when it has this one. `radius` is written in the source text (or is the sum of `radiusParts`).

entryReasons.banner-3: The Banner text: a 3" area of effect. Vanilla banner options (plain, exchanges, bundles) all resolve to the item Banner.
entryReasons.standard-3: A Pennant (a banner) of the Battle Companies equipment table: the same 3" as a banner; merges with it into one ring.
entryReasons.instrument-3: Battle Companies equipment table: 3" around the bearer.
entryReasons.drum-12: War drum text: the At the Double of the free Heroic March has range 12" instead of 6". The Company Drum is a War Drum (isA).
entryReasons.horn-24: War horn text: 24". Correct but it fills the table: group `large`, off by default (Q3). The Company Horn is a War Horn (isA).
entryReasons.horn-standfast-9: War horn text: once per game +3" to a friendly Hero's Stand Fast, or to the bearer's own when it is a Hero (6" + 3"). Only a Hero bearer has the ring (for a Warrior bearer the 9" is centred on the Hero, not on the horn).
entryReasons.torch-6: Battle Companies equipment table: 'illuminate the area within 6"'. Light, not a rule on a model: group `optional`, off by default (spec 2.4).
entryReasons.standfast-6: Glossary Stand Fast (every Hero). With Me! (Heroic Move) and Loose (Heroic Shoot) are universal Heroic Actions with the same 6": their labels are merged.
entryReasons.atthedouble-6: Heroic March is not universal: the Ranger path (or a vanilla profile) gives it. The shout is in the glossary term At the Double.
entryReasons.resolve-6: Warlord path starting Heroic Action; merged into the Hero's 6" command ring.
entryReasons.takeaim-6: Marksman path starting Heroic Action; spec 2.4 lists it as support but says it merges into the 6" command ring, so it is command (REVIEW).
entryReasons.voice-12: Warlord rule: replaces the Hero's 6" command rings (Stand Fast and the shouts) with one 12" ring.
entryReasons.tirade-6: Warlord rule (also the named rule of Lobelia, which the Battle Companies rule replaces).
entryReasons.bellow-3: Warlord rule: 'treat this Hero as a banner with a range of 3"'. Not in the spec table (omitted by mistake); added as a banner ring.
entryReasons.claim-6: Claimant rule (and Freca's vanilla rule, replaced by it): the banner range 6" starts after a game event.
entryReasons.dolamroth-6: Fiefdoms rule: 'a banner with a range of 6"'. Not in the spec table (omitted by mistake); added as a banner ring.
entryReasons.leadbyexample-6: Vanilla rule of Buhrdur, Hill Troll Chieftain (a unit companies can field). Not in the spec table; added as a banner ring.
entryReasons.portents-6: Tactician rule (Oin's vanilla rule of the same name is replaced by it).
entryReasons.goodsort-3: Soldier rule (also Dori's vanilla rule, replaced by it): the bearer benefits when another Hero is near.
entryReasons.toarms-3: Berserker rule (also Thorin's vanilla rule, replaced by it).
entryReasons.lossarnach-3: Fiefdoms rule (also Forlong's vanilla rule, replaced by it).
entryReasons.lamedon-3: Fiefdoms rule (also Angbor's vanilla rule, replaced by it).
entryReasons.moneybags-6: Lake-town rule (also the vanilla rule of the Master of Lake-town, replaced by it).
entryReasons.keensight-12: Falcon creature figure (its own `aura` agrees) and the Crebain of the vanilla file.
entryReasons.battle-6: Warlord option and Rutabi, General of the Dragon Legion (the pattern covers the other variants if a company ever gets them).
entryReasons.challenge-6: Claimant starting Heroic Action: names one Hero.
entryReasons.glove-3: Places one creature; the radius only limits where.
entryReasons.hymn-12: Wood Elf Sentinel: chooses one model.
entryReasons.vines-3: Magical Power: the radius is also around the marker; the ring shows where the marker may go.

outOfScope.reason: scenario layout, deployment and scoring (objectives, board edges, entry points): centred on objectives, markers or the table, never on a unit
missile profiles (bows, crossbows, throwing weapons, the blowpipe, the whip): weapon ranges, listed in `excluded` by the generator
company rules print no distance of their own (the validator checks the keywords they use, which are covered above)
